text: Frame HealHub as a response to everyday healthcare access problems. Keep the explanation practical: the system reduces manual coordination, improves slot visibility, and helps users track appointment status.
Combined stack: MongoDB Atlas + Express.js + React.js + Node.js with secure APIs and cloud deployment.
textPreview: Combined stack: MongoDB Atlas + Express.js + React.js + Node.js with secure APIs and cloud deployment.

text: Describe the stack layer by layer. React and Vite power the frontend, Node and Express handle APIs, MongoDB Atlas stores data, JWT and bcrypt secure user access, and Render/Vercel support deployment.
JWT travels with protected API requests; deployment separates frontend, backend, and cloud database.
textPreview: JWT travels with protected API requests; deployment separates frontend, backend, and cloud database.

text: Explain the three-tier architecture. The React frontend sends Axios requests to Express APIs, protected routes validate JWT tokens, controllers access Mongoose models, and MongoDB Atlas stores persistent data. Mention that Vercel, Render, and Atlas form the deployment architecture.
